summary_md: **Bessi S ([@LLMpsycho](https://x.com/LLMpsycho/status/2115810209214107833))** flags **TokenEconomizer** from Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley (about 486 stars), a plug-in for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and Pi that mines a repo's earlier sessions so the agent reuses commands known to work there, sheds tools it never calls and gets steered out of repeated failure loops ([microsoft/TokenEconomizer](https://github.com/microsoft/TokenEconomizer)).
